name: Yumemiru Key
source:
--Sweet and delicious sweets.
Then a fluffy stuffed animal.
Surrounded by gentle and cute things, you dream of escapism.

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6262]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
——香甜可口的甜点。
然后是毛茸茸的毛绒动物。
被温柔可爱的事物包围，你梦想着逃避现实。

[来自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6262]NovelGame[/url]]
